# netbox_data_files (Data Source)

Retrieves all data files from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_data_files" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "created"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "data_files_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_data_files.example.data_files[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `data_files` (Attributes List) The data files found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_files))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--data_files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_files`

Read-Only:

- `hash` (String) The hash of the data files.
- `id` (Number) The id of the data files.
- `last_updated` (String) When the data files was last changed.
- `path` (String) The path of the data files.
- `size` (Number) The size of the data files.
- `source_id` (Number) The ID of the source associated with the data files.
